## Why

The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-175814-f2ae, item S554. `git -C WORKTREE merge-base main HEAD` was denied with "This command requires approval", while `git show main:PATH` was allowed. A reviewer needs the merge base to name the commit an overlay is built from, and `git merge-base` only reads the commit graph.

The owner decided this in adj 574 (`launch.read-only-merge-base`): add both `Bash(git merge-base*)` and `Bash(git -C * merge-base*)` to `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist` in `internal/engine/perm.go`, after the git show entries. The list is shared by cloud Claude read-only roles and claude-local (adj 489, adj 307), so every read-only role gets the grant, and `CloudUIAllowlist` inherits it.

## Failing tests

- TestReadOnlyRoleOnCloudClaudeGetsTheReadOnlyList (existing, `internal/daemon/runner_test.go`): its `localReadOnlyTools` constant is updated to the new list, with `Bash(git merge-base*)` and `Bash(git -C * merge-base*)` directly after `Bash(git -C * show*)`. The test asserts that each read-only role (reviewer, gate, architect, spec-check, spec-draft) is sent exactly that `--allowedTools` string. It fails until `perm.go` adds the two entries in that order.
- TestReadOnlyAllowlistIncludesMergeBase (new, `internal/engine/perm_test.go`): asserts `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist()` and `CloudUIAllowlist()` each contain both entries, and that `allowlistMatches` accepts `git merge-base main HEAD`, `git -C /w merge-base main HEAD` and `git -C /w merge-base --is-ancestor main HEAD` against them.
- TestReadOnlyAllowlistIncludesMergeBase also asserts that no entry matches a command that is not `merge-base`, such as `git -C /w merge main`, so the wildcard does not widen to other git subcommands.
- The existing TestReadOnlyAllowlistBatch must keep passing: the new entries contain none of `rg`, `$`, `;`, `&&` or `=`.

## Implement

1. In `internal/engine/perm.go` `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist`, add `"Bash(git merge-base*)", "Bash(git -C * merge-base*)",` on a new line directly after the line holding `"Bash(git -C * show*)"`. This puts both after all the git show entries, plain form first.
2. Write `TestReadOnlyAllowlistIncludesMergeBase` in `internal/engine/perm_test.go` first, in the style of `TestReadOnlyAllowlistIncludesSlicerCheck`, and see it fail.
3. Update the `localReadOnlyTools` constant in `internal/daemon/runner_test.go` to insert the two entries in the same position as step 1.
4. In `docs/design.md` (Permissions paragraph, about line 2547), change "`git show` (also with `git -C`)" to name `git merge-base` as well (also with `git -C`, adj 574). Keep the sentence that the additions grant no chains or variables.
